index_format: LLM Memory Wiki compatible page objects + stable mem:// pointers

runtime.vector: embedded deterministic 96D exact cosine mirror; optional VEKTOR Go endpoint probe
runtime.graph: embedded discrete deterministic planning graph; no direct KoL mutation op
runtime.clock: NanoClock browser mirror: wall anchor + monotonic elapsed; observation cadence does not drive canonical time
runtime.learning: localStorage preference/Q overlay only; source authority immutable

authority_invariants: Observation evidence does not authorize execution.
T3 / structural-deny classifications are immutable in the learning overlay.
T2/mutation candidates require explicit human review outside auto-run.
Nested executors are classified by effective downstream action.
Successful tool return is not equivalent to verified state transition.
agent_start: Search the master index, inspect exact mem:// pointers, expand graph neighbors, then produce a bounded route packet. Prefer installed runtime metadata for live KoLmafia facts. Do not use this HTML artifact as execution authority.

sources.title: KoLmafia JS / TS / Relay Reference Matrix

principles: Keep external intel separate from live state
Never use direct/headless/runtime lanes as policy bypasses

workflows.name: Answer a live character-state question
workflows.note: Prefer structured T1 reads; use session/browser evidence only to resolve ambiguity.

workflows.name: Discover an unknown command/function
workflows.note: Pin installed version, then query runtime metadata before using historical docs.

workflows.name: Execute one bounded gCLI action
workflows.note: Prefer a typed action in place of generic run_command whenever one exists.

workflows.name: Run a registered script
workflows.note: Script name and args are part of the authorization scope.

workflows.name: Inspect a relay page
workflows.note: Use browser state as evidence. Do not escalate to click/fill/navigation as an AI mutation route.

workflows.name: Reason about item value or liquidity
workflows.note: Pricegun gives market history; local/searchmall/current account state answers different questions.

workflows.name: Query structured game data
workflows.note: Data of Loathing is game-data intelligence, not live character state.

workflows.name: Resolve a special mechanic
workflows.note: Use the service matching the mechanic, then translate the result back into locally verified KoLmafia state before action.

workflows.name: Investigate fax availability
workflows.note: Website lookup is read-only; actually requesting/sending/receiving shared fax state belongs in a human-gated social/shared-state lane.

workflows.name: Run an explicitly authorized headless job
workflows.note: This is a separate privileged lane. Do not use it to route around MCP structural denial.

workflows.name: Develop with embedded KoLmafia/pymafia
workflows.note: Direct runtime calls need an adapter that applies the same safety model before LLM exposure.

workflows.name: Classify a nested executor
workflows.note: Resolve aliases/scripts/inner command or URL; classify the effective downstream action.

workflows.name: Verify after mutation
workflows.note: A successful tool return is not the same as verified state transition.
